basic_details.job_title: University of Calicut Disability Management Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The University of Calicut needs two Disability Management Officers (Clinical Psychologist) on a contract basis for its Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP). One post is at the Calicut University Unit and one is at the Kannur Unit. Applications on plain paper must reach the Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University PO, Pin-673635 on or before 6 December 2026 (4 pm). The consolidated pay is Rs. 44,000/- per month.

content_sections.heading: About CDMRP, University of Calicut
content_sections.text: The Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP) is a joint project of the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut and the Social Justice Department, Govt. of Kerala. The vacancy notification is dated 24 November 2026 and is issued by the Director - CDMRP, Department of Psychology, University of Calicut. Both posts are in CDMRP units: one at the Calicut University Unit and one at the Kannur Unit.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: There is no prescribed application form. Candidates must write the application on plain paper, giving full bio-data, and send it with the enclosures listed below to this address: Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University PO, Pin-673635 The application must reach this address on or before 6 December 2026 (4 pm). The notice says applications "should reach" by this time, so the date is for receipt, not dispatch. The notice does not mention a particular postal mode or what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Disability Management Officer (Clinical Psychologist), with two vacancies on contract. The notice lists the essential qualification for the Disability Management Officer (Clinical Psychologist) post as follows: M.Sc. Psychology/Applied Psychology of University of Calicut or its equivalent M.Phil Clinical Psychology with valid RCI Registration PhD Qualified in UGC-NET in Psychology The notice prints these four items as a numbered list under "Essential Qualification" and does not say whether every item is compulsory or whether some are alternatives. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility for the post. The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 44,000/- P.M. The mode of appointment is contract, and the appointment is on contractual basis at CDMRP. The notice does not mention the length of the contract or any allowances.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Full bio-data, written on plain paper (the application itself) Passport size attested photograph Attested copies of mark sheets Attested copies of certificates Other necessary documents

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Disability Management Officer (Clinical Psychologist) posts happens in two steps, as the notice describes: All applications will be processed by the Director - CDMRP. The shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview before the selection committee. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Calicut University Recruitment 2026 for CDMRP?
faq.answer: There are two (2) vacancies for Disability Management Officer (Clinical Psychologist): one at the CDMRP Calicut University Unit and one at the Kannur Unit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Disability Management Officer (Clinical Psychologist) post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University PO, Pin-673635 on or before 6 December 2026 (4 pm).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Disability Management Officer (Clinical Psychologist) post?
faq.answer: The notice lists: M.Sc. Psychology/Applied Psychology of University of Calicut or its equivalent; M.Phil Clinical Psychology with valid RCI Registration; PhD; and qualified in UGC-NET in Psychology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the CDMRP Disability Management Officer (Clinical Psychologist)?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 44,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for Calicut University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Write the application on plain paper with full bio-data, attach a passport size attested photograph and attested copies of mark sheets, certificates and other necessary documents, and send it to the Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University PO, Pin-673635.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Disability Management Officer (Clinical Psychologist) posts?
faq.answer: All applications will be processed by the Director - CDMRP, and the shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview before the selection committee.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Disability Management Officer (Clinical Psychologist) job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the mode of appointment is contract; the posts are filled on contractual basis at CDMRP.
